newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Cedel,Austria's OTOB in E. Europe derivatives link.
newsitem.headline: Cedel,Austria's OTOB in E. Europe derivatives link.

text.p: Luxembourg clearer Cedel Bank said in a statement on Monday it had agreed with Austria's OTOB futures and options exchange to act as global collateral manager for traded futures and options linked to a number of East European stock markets.
The U.S.-dollar denominated derivatives are linked to the Polish, Hungarian and Czech traded indices and a new, "CECE" composite index comprising the three plus the Slovak share index.

Cedel said its global collateral security service (GCSS) would be responsible for monitoring margin requirements, daily mark-to-market valuations of collateral, premium and settlement payments and on-line reporting.
"All of the major Austrian banks have signed-up to use the service," Cedel said.

Cedel said GCSS's OTOB service would make use of a link between Cedel and the U.S. Fedwire system for settling U.S. securities, which was set up recently following clearance from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
